title: acetosella frutescens
intro: Acetosella frutescens, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial legume native to Europe, Western Asia, and Northwestern Africa. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing the risk of heart disease and certain cancers, as well as alleviating menopausal symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Red Clover are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving blood flow, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, such as formononetin and genistein, which may contribute to its health benefits.
